title: Kissed Springy Brazilian Leek Grill
description: A fatty and springy Brazilian dish featuring leek, perfect for nostalgic meals, made with double-rise-bread and suitable for sugar-free diets, cooked to perfection on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium heat.
Brush the melted butter onto the bread cubes.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped leeks, minced garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Place a layer of bread cubes onto the raclette-grill.
Add a layer of the leek mixture on top of the bread.
Sprinkle shredded parmesan cheese over the leek layer.
Drizzle olive oil over the cheese layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cook for 20 minutes or until the bread is toasted and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
